reply: Thank you for explaining that people unrelated to the borrower have received calls and voicemails containing loan details. We understand your concern about privacy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a record of who was contacted and when, and send a written request that the servicer contact only the borrower directly. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you refinanced federal loans into a private loan to lower your payments without being told you would lose federal benefits. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask your lender in writing what hardship or payment options are available on your private loan, and keep your correspondence. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your credit report shows duplicate student loan entries from a servicer that no longer manages your loans. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep the transfer notices, and dispute the duplicate entries with each credit reporting company, explaining that the loans moved to a new servicer. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were placed in administrative forbearance even though you asked not to be, and that you were told the interest would be removed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your paperwork and the recorded call, and ask in writing for confirmation of the interest adjustment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that small late payments from 2018 were only shown in your online account, and that you were not otherwise notified. We understand the effect on your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please ask in writing how notices were sent to you, and dispute any inaccurate late entries with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that interest was capitalized after your loan was placed in administrative forbearance without explanation, while you were on SAVE and working toward PSLF. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing why the forbearance was applied and for the capitalized interest to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two servicers have told you that you do not qualify for a forgiveness program you believe you are eligible for. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the specific reasons you were told you do not qualify, and keep your employment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your account moved to a new platform, you lost access to past statements and at least $600.00 in payments appears to be missing. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your bank records of each payment, and send a written request for a full payment history covering the transition. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that one of your loan sequences was forgiven, but the other is still waiting, and that you have been referred between offices. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your case numbers and the updated payment counts, and ask in writing for the status of the remaining loans. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you learned soon after purchase that your car had frame damage, and that you have been paying the loan for years. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the inspection and valuation records, and ask in writing about any options available if you cannot keep up with the payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the contract the lender holds differs from the one the dealer sent you, and that you did not sign it electronically. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep both copies of the contract, and ask the lender in writing for the signing records and the reason the copies differ. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your vehicle was under warranty, but transmission problems were not covered because the warranty had expired. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep your sales contract, warranty documents and repair records, and ask in writing for the warranty terms that applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you co-signed for a truck, the primary borrower left the country with it, and you are now being contacted about late payments. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep your affidavit and any police report, and ask in writing what options are available to you as co-signer. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you see many credit inquiries you do not recognize after your wallet was lost, even though you placed a freeze. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please review your credit reports, and dispute any inquiry you did not authorize with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car was a total loss after an accident, and that an insurance claim was later reported as inactive. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the claim numbers and the accident report, and ask the lender in writing how the claim affects your loan balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your COVID extension would move missed payments to the end of the loan, but were later asked to pay thousands at once. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep any written terms of the extension, and ask in writing for your full payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are facing repossession near the end of your loan after a long period of financial hardship and repeated requests for help. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for a payment arrangement before the repossession date, and keep your payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your remaining balance did not change after your car was repossessed and sold, and that you have not received callbacks. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for the sale price, the repossession fees and how they were applied to your balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your down payment does not seem to have reduced your auto loan, and that the contract was rushed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a copy of the signed contract and a payment history showing how your down payment was applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you traded in a car you had for 30 days, were told you would get money back, and now owe more because of negative equity. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the sales paperwork and any written statements from the dealer, and ask in writing for a breakdown of the amount financed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car was repossessed without the written notice you believe was required, and that your husband was nearly struck during the repossession. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for copies of any notices sent before the repossession. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your leased vehicle was a total loss, and that you have questions about how the $7,500.00 tax credit is reflected in the settlement. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lease team. Please ask in writing for a breakdown of the lease payoff and how the insurance payment will be applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a privacy notice said your information may be shared, and that you do not consent to this. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please follow the opt-out instructions in the privacy notice for any sharing you can limit, and keep a copy of your request. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your deferment would go through and your account would not go past due, but the deferment was denied. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the date of the call and ask in writing for the call to be reviewed and for any other hardship options. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car stopped working two weeks after purchase and needs a new ignition system and computer. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the repair diagnosis and your sales contract, and ask in writing about any warranty or return options for the vehicle. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you tried to work out an arrangement, including surrendering the vehicle, and that the agents were unwilling to discuss options. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send your request in writing, including whether you want to surrender the vehicle, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the extra $38.00 you pay each month was applied to future payments instead of principal, totaling about $640.00. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send written instructions that extra payments go to principal, and ask for the past amounts to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your title transfer has been pending for months even though the title was mailed to the lender. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the title services team. Please keep the dates of your calls and any reference numbers, and ask in writing for the title's current status and an expected completion date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the money order for your DMV registration was not sent with your title, and that no one can tell you where it is. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the title services team. Please keep a copy of the money order receipt, and ask in writing for the money order to be traced. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have not had online access to your auto loan for months and that your statements are being sent to your bank instead of you. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for your mailing address to be corrected and for statements to be sent to you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
